title: HATHERLEIGH PUBLIC LIBRARY: VOLUNTEER AGREEMENT
summary: This is an unpaid volunteer arrangement with Hatherleigh Public Library for the 2026 season, one three hour shift a week from 1 April to 31 October. The volunteer keeps to a rostered shift, signs in and out, gives a day's notice of a shift they cannot work, and keeps borrower records confidential. The Library gives an induction, names a contact for each shift, publishes the roster two weeks ahead, reimburses bus fare up to eight dollars a shift, and covers volunteers on its own insurance. Either side can end it at any time with nothing to pay, and it stops on 31 October rather than renewing, so the 2027 season means a new agreement.
